Add Imports: rvtk DESCRIPTION, configure package one step package root: use_rvtk() writes src/Makevars, src/Makevars.win, tools/configure.R compiler linker flags resolved install time via rvtk::CppFlags() rvtk::LdFlagsFile(). Everything can also set hand — two approaches produce identical files. Pre-built libraries provided macOS (arm64 x86_64), Linux (x86_64 glibc, x86_64 musl/Alpine, aarch64, clang -stdlib=libc++ variant x86_64 glibc), Windows (static shared DLLs). rvtk’s configure script detects compiler’s C++ standard library picks matching Linux archive automatically. ABI compatibility pre-built libraries. pre-built archives compiled GCC libstdc++ (Windows, Rtools45 static.posix MinGW toolchain), except dedicated Linux x86_64 libc++ archive built Clang. Downstream packages use matching toolchain: linking libstdc++ archive Clang -stdlib=libc++ fails load undefined __try_use_facet symbol, linking much newer GCC build toolchain may fail __cxa_call_terminate. Linux x86_64, configure detects standard library compiler targets downloads matching archive; platforms, install system VTK (e.g. via Homebrew apt) toolchain match bundled one.

title: rvtk 0.1.1
text: planned CRAN submission v0.1.0 cancelled downstream package developers reported linker errors building pre-built Windows VTK libraries. Two root causes identified fixed: Wrong toolchain. Windows VTK zip compiled Rtools45 UCRT64 toolchain (/ucrt64/bin/gcc), uses dynamic C runtime emits DLL-import symbols (__imp_fseeko64, __imp_ftello64, …). However, R CMD INSTALL links R packages x86_64-w64-mingw32.static.posix toolchain, fully static. mismatch caused undefined references nanosleep64, ftime64, __imp_fseeko64, __imp_ftello64. GitHub Actions workflow now builds Windows VTK zip x86_64-w64-mingw32.static.posix compiler, matching toolchain downstream packages use. Command-line length overflow. full set VTK -l linker flags exceeds 8 191-character Windows command-line limit, causing linker silently drop flags end list. new function LdFlagsFile(path) writes flags response file returns short @path token GNU ld LLVM lld support. Downstream packages call LdFlagsFile('src/vtk_libs.rsp') configure / configure.win script instead LdFlags().
